reviewer: Independent Codex CLI, read-only source review

logic_errors.finding: Filesystem inspection errors can silently omit entire data categories.
logic_errors.scenario: Path::exists() returns false on metadata errors as well as missing paths. If inspecting sessions or personas_data fails during both capture passes, that directory is skipped twice. The matching partial inventories then qualify as a complete snapshot, omitting session metadata or supporting knowledge.

logic_errors.finding: Backup verification and latest-snapshot recovery download the entire snapshot history.
logic_errors.scenario: Every recovery snapshot contains its full raw files in config_json. Both operations select all columns and paginate to exhaustion. With 100 snapshots containing 10 MiB each, recovering one snapshot downloads and retains approximately 1 GiB before JSON overhead. This creates increasing memory pressure and timeout risk precisely when recovery is needed.

logic_errors.finding: Cancellation and timeout are ignored during the final local verification.
logic_errors.scenario: After cloud readback, snapshotNow awaits export_cloud_snapshot. If the user cancels or the overall deadline expires during that export, an unchanged snapshot still leads directly to status complete because ctx.check() is never called again. The UI reports a verified completion despite cancellation.

suggestions.action: Inspect each category with an error-preserving metadata call. Skip only an explicitly missing optional category; abort on other inspection errors.
Restrict persona readback to expected persona rows. Fetch only the selected recovery snapshot; use metadata-only queries if a snapshot history is needed.
Call ctx.check() after final asynchronous verification and immediately before publishing completion.
Add regression coverage for inaccessible category roots, multiple large snapshot versions, and cancellation during snapshotNow.

initial.summary: Static review found three correctness issues. No files were edited, tests executed, or network calls made. No confirmed security defect was identified in the inspected scope; deployed RLS and second-device recovery remain unverified.

focused_re_review.summary: Focused static review confirms all three fixes: category inspection rejects errors and dangling links; persona readback excludes snapshot history and download requests one envelope; cancellation is checked after snapshotNow and before success. Regression tests cover the reported scenarios. No remaining genuine bugs or nearby introduced risks found. Tests were not executed.

execution: Reviewer did not run tests or cloud operations; parent executed RED/GREEN regressions and release integration.
